title: Bihar SI aspirants march in Patna against cancelled mains exam
seoTitle: Patna march against SI mains exam cancellation

tea.why: The Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) cancelled the sub-inspector mains examination for 1,799 posts.
tea.want: Protesters demand the withdrawal of the mains exam cancellation and announcement of physical test dates.
tea.changed: Oct 5: Aspirants marched from Gandhi Maidan towards the chief minister's residence but were stopped by police.

summary: Aspirants for Bihar Police Sub-Inspector posts held a protest march in Patna on October 5, 2026, against the cancellation of the mains examination by the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC). The commission cancelled the exam for 1,799 posts on September 23, citing "unavoidable reasons." Protesters, who had cleared previous stages and were preparing for physical tests, demanded the cancellation be revoked and physical test dates announced. Some candidates had been staging a sit-in for 10 days prior to the march. They marched from Gandhi Maidan but were stopped by police at JP Golambar. According to a candidate, they questioned the cancellation's timing, as an Economic Offences Unit probe was ongoing.
demands: Withdraw the cancellation of the sub-inspector mains examination
Announce dates for the physical examination
response: Police stopped the marchers at JP Golambar. According to a candidate, protesters met several senior officials, including the Home Secretary, Commission Chairman, and EOU DIG, but received no concrete explanation for the cancellation.

updates.text: The Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) cancelled the sub-inspector mains examination for 1,799 posts, citing "unavoidable reasons".
Job aspirants, who had cleared the preliminary and mains examinations, held a protest march in Patna.
Protesters marched from Gandhi Maidan towards the chief minister's residence but were stopped by police at JP Golambar.
A candidate stated that they had met several senior officials but received no concrete explanation for the cancellation.
